title: AI Penetration Testing Copilot — contract index

contracts.title: Session
contracts.description: Root aggregate for one engagement run.

contracts.title: Session step
contracts.description: A planned or executed unit of work inside a session.

contracts.title: Approval request
contracts.description: Human decision gate blocking session work.

contracts.title: Create session request
contracts.description: Payload accepted when creating a session.

contracts.title: Prompt module
contracts.description: Versioned, composable prompt unit with declared I/O and safety metadata.

contracts.title: Prompt render request
contracts.description: Request to compose and render prompt modules.

contracts.title: Rendered prompt
contracts.description: Immutable rendered prompt ready for the model gateway.

contracts.title: Engine message
contracts.description: Envelope for every engine-to-engine interaction.

contracts.title: Request envelope
contracts.description: Directed call expecting exactly one response.

contracts.title: Response envelope
contracts.description: Terminal reply to a request.

contracts.title: Event envelope
contracts.description: Broadcast fact published on the event bus.

contracts.title: Stream chunk envelope
contracts.description: Ordered chunk of a streaming response.

contracts.title: Domain event
contracts.description: Catalogued event name plus payload.

contracts.title: Plugin manifest
contracts.description: Declarative plugin description: contributions, runtime and permissions.

contracts.title: Installed plugin
contracts.description: Host-side record of an installed plugin.

contracts.title: Model provider configuration
contracts.description: Registration data for a model backend. Contains no secrets.

contracts.title: Model descriptor
contracts.description: Declared capabilities and limits of one model.

contracts.title: Completion request
contracts.description: Provider-agnostic chat/completion request.

contracts.title: Completion response
contracts.description: Normalised provider response.

contracts.title: Completion stream event
contracts.description: Incremental streaming event from a provider.

contracts.title: Embedding request
contracts.description: Provider-agnostic embedding request.

contracts.title: Embedding response
contracts.description: Embedding vectors returned by a provider.

contracts.title: Actor
contracts.description: Principal that can cause changes.

contracts.title: Actor reference
contracts.description: Compact actor reference for high-volume records.

contracts.title: Engagement scope
contracts.description: What may be tested and how.

contracts.title: Rules of engagement
contracts.description: Operational constraints agreed with the client.

contracts.title: Target asset
contracts.description: A single asset that may be tested.

contracts.title: Authorization record
contracts.description: Evidence that testing is authorised.

contracts.title: Finding
contracts.description: A security weakness with evidence and scoring.

contracts.title: Evidence
contracts.description: Verifiable observation supporting a finding.

contracts.title: Artifact
contracts.description: Captured bytes with custody metadata.

contracts.title: Blob reference
contracts.description: Pointer to stored bytes.

contracts.title: Audit record
contracts.description: Immutable, hash-chained record of a security-relevant action.

contracts.title: Metric sample
contracts.description: A single telemetry measurement.

contracts.title: Trace span
contracts.description: A unit of work in a distributed trace.
